title: Edwards v. Miller (A186292)

ORDER OF SUMMARY AFFIRMANCE
Appellate Court Administrator, Appellate Court Records Section
1163 State Street, Salem, Oregon 97301-2563
Page 1 of 1
IN THE COURT OF APPEALS OF THE STATE OF OREGON
Deymon L. Edwards,
Petitioner-Appellant,
v.
Jamie Miller, Superintendent, Snake River Correctional Institution,
Defendant-Respondent.
Malheur County Circuit Court No. 21CV44378
Court of Appeals No. A186292
ORDER OF SUMMARY AFFIRMANCE
Before Egan, Presiding Judge, and Joyce, Judge.
Respondent (the superintendent) moves pursuant to ORS 138.660 for summary
affirmance on the ground that the appeal does not present a substantial question of law.
Petitioner opposes the motion.
The court determines that, for the reasons articulated in the superintendent's
motion, petitioner's pro se supplemental brief does not present a substantial question of
law regarding whether the post-conviction court erred in denying relief. See Mandell v.
Cain, 315 Or App 471, 473, 500 P3d 762 (2021), rev den, 369 Or 507 (2022).
Therefore, the motion is granted.
Affirmed.
James C. Egan
Presiding Judge
1/29/2026
DESIGNATION OF PREVAILING PARTY AND AWARD OF COSTS
Prevailing party: Respondent Costs: No costs allowed
